description: Figure 6(a) is a vertical bar chart illustrating the distribution of sample counts across different reasoning types for the self-reflection SFT dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categorical reasoning-type labels (shown left to right as Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning), with the labels angled; the vertical axis is labeled “Number of Samples” and uses a logarithmic scale with tick marks at powers of ten (approximately 10^1, 10^2, 10^3, and 10^4). Each category is represented by a single light-blue bar with a numeric value printed above it: Mathematical Reasoning is about 70,205; General Reasoning about 17,099; Natural Scene Reasoning about 413; Physical Reasoning about 232; Logical Puzzle Reasoning about 91; and Chemical Reasoning about 49. The bars appear arranged in descending order from left to right, and there are no stacked/grouped components or legend, with emphasis provided only by the value annotations above each bar.
